name: Frostfell Hollow
description: A small cave under the northern fell, white with frost, home to one old man.

f_entry.name: The Frost Arch
f_entry.description: A low arch gives onto a short stair, furred with frost. Beyond it a passage runs into the dark.

f_passage.name: The Rimed Passage
f_passage.description: A narrow passage whose walls glitter with ice where a torch touches them. The air burns in the nose.

f_hall.name: The Hermit's Hall
f_hall.description: A small, cold hall, swept bare, with a stone bench and a staff of grey wood laid across two pegs. An old man in a heavy cloak sits near it.
